newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.

Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed for the week to date, including late Friday and the weekend on 2,700 head. Monday bids at $66.00 per cwt, asking $68.00-$69.00. Last established prices $67.00 on Friday, March 28. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - none last year - 600
Wk to date - 2,700 last week - 5,200 last year - 3,700
